No sentence, word problem, or example from the textbook was copied — statement_en/statement_te below are Tut-P's own composition describing the generic skill, per copyright policy. scf_code is 'unstructured' because AP SCF documents were not found to use a stable per-outcome code system the way this schema's example code implied — that example code was an invented placeholder and has been removed. alignment_type downgraded to 'partial': the textbook teaches fraction-equivalence via paper-folding/area-shading and comparison via number-line placement, not via Singapore-Math-style bar models specifically — both are 'pictorial' CPA stage and cover the same underlying skill, but the representation Tut-P would generate (bar model) is not literally what's printed in the state textbook. Edition year is uncertain — the mirror found is dated 2019; needs re-check for the current-year edition before shipping.
